description: CAPRA (Probabilistic Risk Assessment) is a platform initiative to strengthen institutional capacity to assess, understand and communicate disaster risk and to bring risk information into development policies and programmes, through software, documentation, training and advisory services. Its modules cover hazard and climate change (geologic and hydrometeorological hazard tools), exposure and vulnerability (locating, classifying and valuing exposed infrastructure, with the FUNVUL vulnerability tools), risk assessment and risk financing. The core CAPRA-GIS is a geographic information system by ERN Latin America, built at ITEC Ltda in Colombia, that computes probabilistic losses from hazard scenarios, exposure and physical vulnerability, with metrics such as expected annual loss and loss exceedance curves; a QGIS plug-in has also been released. Coverage is any region users model, with applications mostly in Latin America. CAPRA-GIS version 2.4.0 (64-bit) and 2.0.0 (32-bit) for Windows are accessible online as free downloads with an English manual, alongside e-learning and videos. Caveats: the Windows tools are dated (copyright 2011) and news on the site stops in 2020, and source code is not offered on the site. It supports multi-hazard risk and hazard exposure assessment of infrastructure portfolios for planning and risk financing; related records are the OpenQuake engine, Oasis LMF, RiskScape and CLIMADA.
